Name: AllowDatagramProcessingOnWinServer
Control Name: This setting controls datagram processing for Network Protection is enabled on Server
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls datagram processing for Network Protection on Windows Server. Enables network-level protection against web-based threats.
Security Impact: Disabling removes network-layer threat protection, exposing the server to web-based attacks and malicious network traffic.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Disabling reduces defense-in-depth; verify no third-party network protection replaces it.

Name: AllowNetworkProtectionOnWinServer
Control Name: This setting controls whether Network Protection is allows to be configured into block or Audit mode on Windows Server
Registry Key: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Enables Microsoft Defender Network Protection on Windows Server, blocking connections to malicious domains and IPs.
Security Impact: Disabling removes DNS/IP reputation blocking, allowing connections to known malicious endpoints.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Disabling weakens network threat protection; may be needed if third-party proxy/firewall handles this.

Name: ASRBlockAbuseOfExploitedVulnerableSignedDrivers
Control Name: Block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks applications from writing vulnerable signed drivers to disk, preventing kernel-level exploits.
Security Impact: Disabling allows exploitation of vulnerable signed drivers for kernel-level privilege escalation.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Disabling exposes to driver-based exploits; audit mode recommended for initial deployment.

Name: ASRBlockAdobeReaderFromCreatingChildProcesses
Control Name: Block Adobe Reader from creating child processes
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that prevents Adobe Reader from creating child processes, blocking PDF-based malware execution chains.
Security Impact: Disabling allows PDF documents to launch arbitrary processes via Adobe Reader.
Change Risk Level: Low - Server environments rarely use Adobe Reader; minimal operational impact.

Name: ASRBlockEXEFromEmailClientAndWebmail
Control Name: Block executable content from email client and webmail
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks executable content from email clients and webmail, preventing email-based malware delivery.
Security Impact: Disabling allows email-delivered executables to run directly from mail clients.
Change Risk Level: Low - Servers typically do not run email clients; minimal operational impact.

Name: ASRBlockEXEFromRunningUnlessTrusted
Control Name: Block executable files from running unless they meet a prevalence, age, or trusted list criterion
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks executables from running unless they meet prevalence, age, or trusted list criteria.
Security Impact: Disabling allows unknown or untrusted executables to run without reputation checks.
Change Risk Level: Medium - May block legitimate but uncommon tools; test in audit mode first.

Name: ASRBlockJSVBSLaunchingDownloadedContent
Control Name: Block JavaScript or VBScript from launching downloaded executable content
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks JavaScript and VBScript from launching downloaded executable content.
Security Impact: Disabling allows script-based download-and-execute attack chains.
Change Risk Level: Low - Server workloads rarely depend on JS/VBS downloading executables.

Name: ASRBlockLSASSCredentialStealing
Control Name: Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem (lsass.exe)
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks credential theft from the LSASS process, preventing tools like Mimikatz from harvesting credentials.
Security Impact: Disabling allows credential dumping tools to extract passwords and hashes from memory.
Change Risk Level: High - Critical credential protection; disabling creates severe credential theft risk.

Name: ASRBlockOfficeApplicationsFromCreatingChildProcesses
Control Name: Block all Office applications from creating child processes
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks Office applications from creating child processes, preventing macro-based malware execution.
Security Impact: Disabling allows Office macros to launch arbitrary processes.
Change Risk Level: Low - Servers rarely run Office applications interactively.

Name: ASRBlockOfficeCommunicationApplicationFromCreatingChildProcesses
Control Name: Block Office communication application from creating child processes
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks Office communication apps (e.g., Outlook) from creating child processes.
Security Impact: Disabling allows communication apps to launch arbitrary child processes.
Change Risk Level: Low - Servers rarely run Outlook or Teams interactively.

Name: ASRBlockOfficeFromCreatingExecutableContent
Control Name: Block Office applications from creating executable content
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks Office applications from creating executable content on disk.
Security Impact: Disabling allows Office macros to drop executables to the file system.
Change Risk Level: Low - Servers rarely run Office; minimal operational impact.

Name: ASRBlockOfficeFromInjectingCodeIntoProcesses
Control Name: Block Office applications from injecting code into other processes
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks Office applications from injecting code into other processes.
Security Impact: Disabling allows Office-based process injection attacks.
Change Risk Level: Low - Servers rarely run Office; minimal operational impact.

Name: ASRBlockPersistenceThroughWMIEventSubscription
Control Name: Block persistence through WMI event subscription (File and folder exclusions not supported)
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks persistence mechanisms using WMI event subscriptions, a common living-off-the-land technique.
Security Impact: Disabling allows attackers to establish persistent footholds via WMI event subscriptions.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Blocking may affect legitimate monitoring tools using WMI subscriptions.

Name: ASRBlockPotentiallyObfuscatedScripts
Control Name: Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks execution of potentially obfuscated scripts, detecting and preventing script-based evasion.
Security Impact: Disabling allows obfuscated malicious scripts to execute without inspection.
Change Risk Level: Medium - May flag legitimate encoded scripts; test in audit mode first.

Name: ASRBlockProcessCreationFromPSExecAndWMICommands
Control Name: Block process creations originating from PSExec and WMI commands
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks process creations originating from PSExec and WMI commands. Baseline sets Audit (2) for Azure Local because LCM depends on WMI orchestration.
Security Impact: Setting to Block (1) prevents WMI-based remote process creation, breaking lifecycle management orchestration.
Change Risk Level: High - Setting to Block breaks remote management tools that rely on WMI; keep as Audit on managed servers.

Name: ASRBlockRebootingMachineInSafeMode
Control Name: Block rebooting machine in Safe Mode (preview)
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks processes from rebooting the machine into Safe Mode, preventing attackers from disabling security controls.
Security Impact: Disabling allows malware to reboot into Safe Mode where security tools are disabled.
Change Risk Level: Low - Minimal operational impact; Safe Mode reboots are rarely needed in production.

Name: ASRBlockUntrustedAndUnsignedProcessesRunningFromUSB
Control Name: Block untrusted and unsigned processes that run from USB
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks untrusted and unsigned processes from running from USB removable drives.
Security Impact: Disabling allows execution of untrusted code from removable media.
Change Risk Level: Low - Server environments rarely use USB drives; minimal operational impact.

Name: ASRBlockUseOfCopiedOrImpersonatedSystemTools
Control Name: Block use of copied or impersonated system tools (preview)
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks use of copied or impersonated system tools, preventing living-off-the-land binary (LOLBin) abuse.
Security Impact: Disabling allows attackers to use renamed copies of system tools to evade detection.
Change Risk Level: Medium - May affect legitimate admin tools if they copy system binaries; test in audit mode.

Name: ASRBlockWebshellCreationForServers
Control Name: Block Webshell creation for Servers
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks webshell creation on servers, preventing web-based backdoor deployment.
Security Impact: Disabling allows creation of webshell files that provide persistent remote access to attackers.
Change Risk Level: High - Critical server protection; webshells are a primary post-exploitation technique.

Name: ASRBlockWIN32APIFromOfficeMacros
Control Name: Block Win32 API calls from Office macros
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that blocks Win32 API calls from Office macros, preventing advanced macro-based attacks.
Security Impact: Disabling allows Office macros to call Win32 APIs for system-level operations.
Change Risk Level: Low - Servers rarely run Office macros; minimal operational impact.

Name: ASRUseAdvancedProtectionAgainstRansomware
Control Name: Use advanced protection against ransomware
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: ASR rule that enables advanced heuristic protection against ransomware behavior patterns.
Security Impact: Disabling removes ransomware-specific behavioral detection, relying only on signature-based protection.
Change Risk Level: High - Critical anti-ransomware layer; disabling significantly increases ransomware risk.

Name: AttackSurfaceReductionRules
Control Name: Configure Attack Surface Reduction rules
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Master configuration for Attack Surface Reduction rules. Controls whether individual ASR rules are enabled, audited, or disabled.
Security Impact: Disabling removes all ASR protections at once, eliminating a critical defense-in-depth layer.
Change Risk Level: High - Master switch for all ASR rules; disabling removes multiple security protections simultaneously.

Name: DisableAntiSpyware
Control Name: Turn off Microsoft Defender AntiVirus
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls whether Microsoft Defender Antivirus is enabled. Must be 0 (enabled) to provide antimalware protection.
Security Impact: Enabling this setting (value 1) completely disables Microsoft Defender AV, removing all malware protection.
Change Risk Level: High - Disabling the antivirus engine removes all real-time and scan-based malware protection.

Name: DisableAutoExclusions
Control Name: Turn off Auto Exclusions
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls automatic exclusions for server roles. When enabled, Defender automatically excludes files/paths for detected server roles.
Security Impact: Disabling auto-exclusions may cause performance impact on server workloads or false positives on role-specific files.
Change Risk Level: Low - Auto-exclusions are a performance optimization; disabling increases scan coverage but may impact performance.

Name: DisableBehaviorMonitoring
Control Name: Turn on behavior monitoring
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls real-time behavior monitoring for suspicious process activity patterns.
Security Impact: Disabling removes behavioral detection of fileless malware and living-off-the-land attacks.
Change Risk Level: High - Behavioral monitoring catches threats that signature-based detection misses.

Name: DisableBlockAtFirstSeen
Control Name: Configure the 'Block at First Sight' feature
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls Block at First Seen (BAFS), which uses cloud intelligence to block new malware within seconds of first detection.
Security Impact: Disabling removes rapid cloud-based verdict for unknown files, increasing window of exposure to zero-day threats.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Requires cloud connectivity; disconnected environments cannot use this feature.

Name: DisableEmailScanning
Control Name: Turn on e-mail scanning
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls scanning of email files (PST, DBX, MBX) by the Defender scan engine.
Security Impact: Disabling prevents detection of malware stored in email archives on the server.
Change Risk Level: Low - Most servers do not store email locally; impact depends on workload.

Name: DisableIOAVProtection
Control Name: Scan all downloaded files and attachments
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls scanning of all downloaded files and attachments (IOAV = Internet Originated Attachment/Volume).
Security Impact: Disabling removes automatic scanning of files downloaded from the internet.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Important for servers that download content; less relevant for isolated infrastructure.

Name: DisableRealtimeMonitoring
Control Name: Turn off real-time protection
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls real-time file access scanning. Must be 0 (enabled) for continuous malware protection.
Security Impact: Disabling removes all real-time file scanning, allowing malware to execute without detection.
Change Risk Level: High - Real-time protection is the primary defense layer; disabling creates critical exposure.

Name: DisableRemovableDriveScanning
Control Name: Scan removable drives
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls scanning of removable drives (USB) during full scans.
Security Impact: Disabling prevents detection of malware on removable media during scans.
Change Risk Level: Low - Server environments rarely use removable drives; minimal impact.

Name: DisableRoutinelyTakingAction
Control Name: Turn off routine remediation
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls whether Defender automatically remediates detected threats or requires manual action.
Security Impact: Enabling prevents automatic remediation, leaving detected threats active until manually addressed.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Manual remediation increases response time; automatic action is preferred for servers.

Name: DisableScanOnUpdate
Control Name: Turn on scan after security intelligence update
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls whether a scan is triggered after a security intelligence (signature) update.
Security Impact: Disabling prevents immediate scanning with new signatures, delaying detection of newly-identified threats.
Change Risk Level: Low - Scheduled scans still occur; post-update scan is an additional detection opportunity.

Name: DisableScriptScanning
Control Name: Turn on script scanning
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls real-time scanning of scripts (PowerShell, VBScript, JavaScript) during execution.
Security Impact: Disabling removes script-level malware detection, a critical vector for fileless attacks.
Change Risk Level: High - Script scanning is essential for detecting PowerShell-based attacks on servers.

Name: DisallowExploitProtectionOverride
Control Name: Prevent users from modifying settings
Registry Key: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\App and Browser protection
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Prevents users from modifying Exploit Protection settings, ensuring centrally managed mitigations remain enforced.
Security Impact: Allowing overrides lets users weaken exploit mitigations on individual applications.
Change Risk Level: Low - Administrative setting; minimal operational impact.

Name: EnableConvertWarnToBlock
Control Name: Convert warn verdict to block
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Converts Network Protection warn verdicts to block actions, enforcing stricter network filtering.
Security Impact: Disabling allows users to bypass network protection warnings and access potentially malicious sites.
Change Risk Level: Low - Strengthens network protection; minimal operational impact on servers.

Name: EngineRing
Control Name: Select the channel for Microsoft Defender monthly engine updates
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls the update ring for the Defender antimalware engine, determining how quickly engine updates are received.
Security Impact: Changing to a slower ring delays engine updates, potentially missing protection improvements.
Change Risk Level: Low - Update ring selection is an operational choice; production servers typically use stable ring.

Name: HideExclusionsFromLocalAdmins
Control Name: Control whether or not exclusions are visible to Local Admins
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Hides configured scan exclusions from local administrators, preventing exclusion discovery for evasion.
Security Impact: Showing exclusions allows attackers to discover safe paths for placing malware.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Security hardening; may complicate legitimate troubleshooting of exclusion issues.

Name: HideExclusionsFromLocalUsers
Control Name: Control whether exclusions are visible to local users
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Hides configured scan exclusions from standard users, preventing exclusion discovery.
Security Impact: Showing exclusions to users allows potential discovery of unmonitored paths.
Change Risk Level: Low - Standard users should not see security configuration details.

Name: LocalSettingOverrideSpynetReporting
Control Name: Configure local setting override for reporting to Microsoft MAPS
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls whether local policy can override cloud protection (MAPS) reporting settings.
Security Impact: Allowing local overrides lets individual machines opt out of cloud-based threat intelligence sharing.
Change Risk Level: Low - Administrative enforcement setting; minimal operational impact.

Name: MpCloudBlockLevel
Control Name: Select cloud protection level
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Sets the aggressiveness of cloud-based blocking. Higher levels increase detection but may cause more false positives.
Security Impact: Lowering the cloud block level reduces detection of emerging threats from cloud intelligence.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Higher levels may cause false positives; balance with workload requirements.

Name: OobeEnableRtpAndSigUpdate
Control Name: Configure real-time protection and Security Intelligence Updates during OOBE
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Enables real-time protection and signature updates during the Out of Box Experience (OOBE), ensuring protection from first boot.
Security Impact: Disabling leaves the system unprotected during initial setup, creating a window of vulnerability.
Change Risk Level: Low - Only affects initial deployment; production servers are past OOBE.

Name: PlatformRing
Control Name: Select the channel for Microsoft Defender monthly platform updates
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls the update ring for the Defender platform, determining how quickly platform updates are received.
Security Impact: Changing to a slower ring delays platform updates and new feature availability.
Change Risk Level: Low - Update ring selection is an operational choice.

Name: PUAProtection
Control Name: Configure detection for potentially unwanted applications
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Enables detection and blocking of Potentially Unwanted Applications (PUA) such as adware and bundleware.
Security Impact: Disabling allows PUA software to install without detection or blocking.
Change Risk Level: Low - PUA is less relevant on servers but provides defense-in-depth.

Name: QuickScanIncludeExclusions
Control Name: Scan excluded files and directories during quick scans
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls whether quick scans also scan files in exclusion paths, providing additional coverage.
Security Impact: Excluding these paths from quick scans reduces scan coverage.
Change Risk Level: Low - Quick scan scope adjustment; full scans still cover all paths.

Name: SchedulerRandomizationTime
Control Name: Configure scheduled task times randomization window
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Sets the randomization window (in hours) for scheduled scan start times to avoid all machines scanning simultaneously.
Security Impact: No randomization causes all machines to scan at the same time, potentially causing resource spikes.
Change Risk Level: Low - Performance optimization; no security impact.

Name: SignaturesRing
Control Name: Select the channel for Microsoft Defender daily security intelligence updates
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls the update ring for signature/security intelligence updates.
Security Impact: Slower ring delays signature updates, increasing the window of exposure to newly identified threats.
Change Risk Level: Low - Update ring selection; production typically uses stable ring.

Name: SpynetReporting
Control Name: Join Microsoft MAPS
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls Microsoft MAPS (cloud protection) membership level. Advanced membership provides enhanced cloud-based protection.
Security Impact: Disabling MAPS removes cloud-based threat intelligence, relying only on local signatures.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Cloud intelligence significantly improves detection; required for Block at First Seen.

Name: SubmitSamplesConsent
Control Name: Send file samples when further analysis is required
Availability: Domain Controller, Member Server, Workgroup Member
Description: Controls automatic sample submission to Microsoft for cloud analysis. Safe samples (no PII) are sent by default.
Security Impact: Disabling prevents cloud-based deep analysis of suspicious files.
Change Risk Level: Medium - Required for full cloud protection; disconnected environments cannot use this.
